Interface KnowledgeService<Q,R>

Type Parameters:
Q - the request record type
R - the result record type
All Known Subinterfaces:
BindingsGenerator, KnowledgeBaseAssembler, KnowledgeExporter, KnowledgeVerifier
public interface KnowledgeService<Q,R>
Base contract of every knowledge-pipeline service: a typed execution method plus the properties-codec bridge that lets IkeServiceBootstrap drive any service generically across the forked-JVM seam. The wire format is a flat properties file — string-typing is confined to serialization; the contract is the typed interfaces.

Concrete service interfaces (KnowledgeBaseAssembler, KnowledgeExporter, BindingsGenerator, KnowledgeVerifier) supply default implementations of the codec methods delegating to their request/result records, and a default execute(Object) delegating to their named method — an implementation overrides only that named method.
